properties.basis_en: Abdallab sources say their armies expanded the realm 'to the borders of Abyssinia and Suakin in the east, to Kab Bulul at the borders of the Fur sultanate in the west, and to Arbaji, which was taken as the dividing line between Abdallab and Funj influence, in the south' (MSM1972 p.149). The northern limit is disputed: Abdallab tradition says Aswan (p.149); others put it at the Third Cataract (p.151). Zone kept EDITORIAL and APPROXIMATE.
